item.title: He Left For A Test Drive And Never Came Home
item.description: Tim Bosma disappeared in 2013 after taking Dellen Millard and Mark Smich for a test drive of his truck. Investigators later found evidence that Bosma had been killed and his remains burned. Both men were convicted of first-degree murder, exposing links to another killing.
